title: A mic test whose device failed keeps requesting 30 fps animation ticks
trigger: Settings > Calls, Test microphone with no usable device (test.source.error() is Some)
effect: request_animation_tick(30) and last_render.set run before the error early return, so the watchdog never stops the test and the page redraws while it is visible
fix: Return the error before ticking and move a failed test to MicTestRun::Failed(reason)

title: DeviceLink::Linking holds no RequestId; clear_device_qr resets session device_login while the confirm request is still out
trigger: Paste a device login link and confirm (Linking), leave the Devices page (clear_device_qr resets DeviceLink and session.settings.device_login to Idle but sessions_op stays Running), return and paste another link and confirm
effect: confirm_device_login is refused (sessions_op mutating) so the page says the device could not be linked although nothing was sent; the first link's real answer (Linked) arrives later and is dropped by poll_device_qr because the stage is not Linking, so the user is never told the device linked
fix: DeviceLink::Linking(RequestId) matched against the answer's request id; keep the pending id across page leave (or cancel it) instead of resetting device_login by hand

title: arm_force_reply_here takes the pending target before apply_force_reply can refuse it, so a force reply that arrives while the composer already has a reply is lost
trigger: In a chat, start replying to message X; a bot sends a standalone force-reply message in that chat
effect: The pending target is removed (line 58), apply_force_reply returns at chat_ui.has_reply() (custom_keyboard.rs:241), so the bot's prompt never arms; the chat's custom keyboard is still dismissed (lines 61-72) although nothing was armed
fix: take the target only when apply_force_reply arms it (return a bool/Armed result), leave it waiting otherwise

title: Esc in the call window never closes the invite or share box
trigger: Open Invite Members or Share Invite Link over the voice chat window, press Esc
effect: Esc does nothing (group_call_window_escape and the esc_stack layers list privacy, Settings, rename only); the box closes only by its own button
fix: one CallWindowBox enum (Privacy/Settings/Rename/Invite/Share/StreamOverlay) with a topmost-first close

title: A failed first boosts page is drawn as an empty list with no Retry
trigger: Open the boosts page (or switch All/Gifts) and getChatBoosts answers with an error
effect: stage Failed with no rows passes the 'not loading' test, so the page shows '0 boosts' and 'No boosts yet' above the error text; next_offset is empty so there is no Show more and no Retry (only re-clicking the tab resends)
fix: Match on PageStage: draw Failed with no rows as an error with a Retry button, and only draw 'No boosts yet' for Ready

title: A failed @bot lookup latches for that username: Failed counts as resolved, so it is never re-asked
trigger: Type @somebot query while offline or while searchPublicChat fails (Failed 'Could not look up'); go back online and retype the same @somebot query
effect: The panel keeps showing the old failure line; no lookup is sent again until another bot username replaces the session slot
fix: A resolve Fetch-like stage where Failed (transient) is re-asked on the next composer event; clear the slot/copy when the trigger goes away

title: open_mask_sets sets the sticker manager's open flag before the request and leaves it set when the request is refused
trigger: Not connected (chats path inactive, so ConnectDriver::open_mask_sets returns Err) -> click 'Manage masks' in the photo editor's Stickers mode
effect: A 'could not load masks' note shows and the box does not open (MaskSets is_open reads masks.dialog_open, still false), but Session::stickers.manager.open stays true: pump_sticker_manager keeps running ensure_manager_covers (sticker set cover downloads) after every answer with nothing shown, until some manager box is opened and closed
fix: One stage owned by the box (opened only after the send succeeds, or derived from masks.dialog_open / the settings box flag instead of a second flag); on Err call set_sticker_manager_open(false)

title: Message-media edit render lands by (chat, message) of the pending edit, not by a render id
trigger: Press Done in the photo editor of a message edit, cancel the edit and enter edit of the same message again (or press Done twice) before the first render finishes
effect: The stale render's PNG is applied as the replacement photo of the new edit session, or the second render overwrites the first; the user sees a photo they did not choose
fix: A `Rendering { id }` stage of the message edit's media (the NEXT_RENDER number), applied only when the id still matches

title: Send stops the record preview only after taking the capture, so the preview keeps playing
trigger: Pause a voice recording, press the preview Play, then press Send (also the story-reply Send, story_viewer/reply_media.rs:521)
effect: The preview audio keeps playing to its end after the message is sent; nothing ends it because the preview clock went with the capture and check_record_preview no longer sees it
fix: stop_record_preview must run before take_voice, or take_voice returns the preview so the caller stops the player

title: Host::Asked ends by 'no request in flight at all', not by the request that asked
trigger: A window asks for a session-wide box (open_box_in inserts Host::Asked(window), dialog_hosts.rs:205) before the answer that sets its flag; that request fails or is cancelled while any unrelated request (download, poll, other ask) is still pending, or the session is a demo.
effect: The ask is only expired in sync_host_dialogs when live.driver.session.requests.is_empty() and the flag is clear (never in a demo, never while locked), so until then an open that names no window shows in the stale asking window instead of the window of the last press, and a chat window that closed cannot clear it by its own close.
fix: Host::Asked { window, request: RequestId } expired by that request settling (answer, error, cancel, owner going away)

title: A statistics send that fails leaves the panel on Loading statistics with no retry
trigger: Open the story Statistics panel when the send fails (fetch_story_insights returns Err after clear_story_insights, e.g. the chats path is not active)
effect: Only a transient status note shows the error; story_stats_panel finds no insights for the story and draws 'Loading statistics' forever without the Retry button (Retry exists only for StoryStatsFetch::Failed); the user must close and reopen the panel
fix: On a failed send put the insights in StoryStatsFetch::Failed (keeping the story key) so the panel shows its error and Retry

title: AgeCheck is a two-variant flag that nothing ever clears
trigger: Tap Verify my age (opens the bot), finish or abandon it; later the server asks for age verification again
effect: AgeCheck::Started stays for the whole run, so age_gate_blocks never shows the prompt again and Show 18+ Content is sent straight to the server; drain_account_notices closes the notice when the condition clears but not age_check, although its comment says the check is done. AccountBoxes::age_check is set only here (Started) and read at toggle_sensitive_content; no reset on condition cleared, account change is covered only by OnScreen drop
fix: Fold into OpenNotice/an Option owned by the age_verification condition (e.g. AgeVerify { started }) so it ends when the condition goes away
